name: VCR_en_easy
description: Visual Commonsense Reasoning (VCR) benchmark that tests higher-order cognition and commonsense reasoning beyond simple object recognition. Models must answer challenging questions about images and provide rationales justifying their answers. The benchmark measures the ability to infer people's actions, goals, and mental states from visual context.
typical_sota_score: ~80–90% Q→A accuracy (frontier multimodal models as of 2024)
reputation: Published at CVPR 2019; large-scale visual commonsense benchmark with rationale annotation; includes both Q→A and QA→R tasks; human performance ~90.6%
notes: Published at CVPR 2019. Contains ~110K multiple-choice QA pairs derived from movie and TV scenes. VCR-en-easy refers to the English easy subset. The full VCR benchmark has two tasks: question answering (Q→A) and answer rationale (QA→R). Includes images from the COCO and VCR-specific movies/TV datasets. Human performance ~91%.
